text:
Sam Patel: Quick heads-up — planning to unpin runtime v2.15 on canary during the night window (2024-10-12 23:30 PT). This is to validate v2.16 routing and KV cache improvements. :eyes:

deploybot: Scheduled job created: unpin-runtime v2.15 -> enable v2.16 (job id: jb-20241012-2300). Dry-run passes basic validation.

Maria Gomez: Thanks. Two quick Qs: 1) Which models are in the canary cohort? 2) Do we have an SDK compatibility gate to prevent older clients from hitting the new runtime?

Sam Patel: Canary cohort = llama3q-small, gpt3a-embed-test, and rerank-beta. SDK gate: we should require sdk>=1.4 for routing to v2.16. I can add a tag check to the deploy job.

Jin Park: Add telemetry sanity checks too — verify avg token latency and 95p latency during the first 10m. If 95p > 200ms for any model, trigger automatic rollback to pinned runtime v2.14.

Rafael Oliveira: Also watch for model-binding mismatches with quantized variants. We had a crash last sprint when sdk 1.3 clients called the q4-based model on the newer runtime. Suggest preflight smoke-run: `./tools/canary_smoke.sh --models llama3q-small,gpt3a-embed-test --seq 128` and require 0 failures.

Maria Gomez: Good call. Can we gate the unpin behind both the SDK tag and the smoke-run pass? Otherwise we risk noisy errors overnight.

Sam Patel: Yep — plan: deploybot will run smoke-run; then check client-sdk metadata for sdk>=1.4; only then flip routing. If either check fails, job aborts. I'll update the job spec in the runbook.

deploybot: Note: added preflight steps -> smoke-run, sdk-tag-check. Will post results back to this thread.

Jin Park: For rollback heuristics, recommend: if error rate increases by >5% for 5m OR 95p latency spikes >200ms for 10m, do an immediate rollback. Also set a sticky-pin window of 30m after rollback so we can triage without flapping.

Rafael Oliveira: Can we also exclude legacy quantized models (q4_0) from canary routing? Keep them pinned until QA gives explicit signoff. I'll update the model-exempt list.

Maria Gomez: I'll prepare a short release note blurb for CS/support explaining the canary, what to watch for, and how to escalate. Link to runbook please so support can see rollback steps.

Sam Patel: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pulls/142 — includes smoke command, sdk gate, rollback thresholds, and who to page.

deploybot: Preflight smoke-run queued (canary cohort). Estimated run time ~3m.

Sam Patel: Who's on-call to watch the window? @Jin Park can you own the initial 30m? Rafael can be backup. Maria will monitor support channels.

Jin Park: I can take the first 30. Will have alerts unmuted and a quick dashboard pinned. :thumbsup:

Rafael Oliveira: I'll stay reachable for rollback assist. If anything weird shows up in model-bind logs, DM me.

deploybot: Smoke-run completed: 0/180 failures, avg latency within baseline. SDK-tag check: 92% of traffic tagged sdk>=1.4; remaining 8% are legacy clients and were excluded from canary routing.

Sam Patel: Perfect — proceeding to flip routing at 23:30 PT. Rolling out with 10% traffic, ramp to 50% over 15m, then 100% over 45m if healthy.

Maria Gomez: I've posted the support note in #support and added monitoring playbook.

Jin Park: Monitoring dashboards live. I'll watch 95p and error-rate; will call rollback if thresholds crossed.

Rafael Oliveira: Added q4_0 to pinned-exceptions list in deploybot config.

deploybot: Rollout started at 2024-10-12T23:30:00Z. Traffic routing: 10% -> v2.16. Job id: jb-20241012-2300.

Sam Patel: Thanks everyone. Ping here if you see anything abnormal.

Maria Gomez: :raised_hands: Good luck team.

Jin Park: :thumbsup:

Rafael Oliveira: :rocket:
